name: propwise-customer-dashboard
description: Full-stack Customer Activity Dashboard — NestJS + Next.js

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n infra,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "docker compose up postgres redis" "pnpm -C backend run start:dev" "pnpm -C frontend run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm -C backend run build && pnpm -C frontend run build
scripts.lint: pnpm -C backend run lint && pnpm -C frontend run lint
scripts.install:all: pnpm -C backend install && pnpm -C frontend install
